explication: Roast is a Ruby DSL for authoring and running structured AI workflows. Users define configuration and execution scopes, then compose cogs whose outputs can feed later cogs; execution supports reusable scopes, collection mapping, repetition, and control flow. The graph shows that workflow runtime plus the documented chat, local-agent, command, and Ruby capabilities. Provider internals are represented where the source index identifies substantial modules; their detailed call relationships are not established by the excerpts, so those links are left unverified.
